programme.title: Steve Mazan
programme.desc: Steve Mazan shot out of the famous San Francisco scene that produced comedy legends such as Robin Williams and Dana Carvey. In his decade-plus career, Steve has done stand-up everywhere from clubs and colleges across the country to corporate events, cruises, and many television shows including The Late Show with David Letterman. He even won an Emmy for his work writing on The Ellen Degeneres Show. His clean and clever comedy landed him on Letterman, The Late Late Show with Craig Ferguson, The Bob & Tom Radio Show, Sirius/XM Radio and more. He's even done audience warm-up for shows such as Deal or No Deal. But of all the performances Steve has done, he is most proud of his eight trips to Iraq and Afghanistan to perform for our troops. He's also the subject of the award-winning film “Dying to do Letterman.”

programme.title: Andrew Rivers
programme.desc: Andrew's very personal and fun storytelling comedy, combined with his exemplary work ethic has earned him high praise from some of the best comedians in the business. Andrew is a featured writer, actor, and comedian on the TV show “UpLate NW.” Andrew has been featured on NBC, FOX, and the Bob & Tom Radio Show and is a regular opening act for Christopher Titus. Andrew was also featured on the popular Buzzfeed web series “Truth or Drink“, has performed in over 35 states and his new podcast called “Don't Quit Your Night Job” was featured in the Seattle Times.

programme.title: Daren Streblow
programme.desc: Daren Streblow's unique style of observational stand-up comedy has been entertaining hundreds-of-thousands of people throughout the United States and around the world since he first stepped on the stage in 1995. Daren headlines churches, fundraisers, corporate functions, and colleges all over North America. He's a “humor opportunist” who is always looking for the comical side of life and how people live it. He takes topics that everyone can relate to and filters them through his unique lens where connecting A to B leads to a letter in the Greek alphabet or maybe salad dressing.

programme.title: Eric O Shea

Every year since 1997, Eric has performed an average of 70 shows a year, and has received 7 nominations as the “National College Comedian of the Year”

programme.title: The Maury Show

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Venancio encuentra a Lázara con Pablo Barranco y éste como es de esperar le hace un escándalo por celos. Sin darse cuenta que Carlos Enrique es testigo de este escándalo escucha toda la discusión de Venancio y Lázara. Allí Carlos Enrique escucha de un tal Pablo y empieza a tener un ataque de celos por Lázara, lo cual lo confunde porque debería estar celoso de su esposa Nancy, pero lejos de ello se enceguece y le pide explicaciones a Lázara sobre Pablo. Cuando Lázara creía que era imposible el romance con Carlos Enrique era imposible por estar casado, éste se presenta pidiéndole explicaciones del tal Pablo. Allí ella se da cuenta que no es ella sola quien está enamorada

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Tras un año de separación y sintiéndose alertada del regreso de Armando a Venezuela Finita visita su casa al buscar retomar su antiguo romance ahora avalada con el derecho de ser una mujer divorciada | Finita observa con horror la realización de su mas nefasta pesadilla al encontrarse con Natalia quien se presenta ante ella como la novia de Armando. en el local de persianas Botero se autocompadece de su situación como hombre y empleador tras haber perdido a Wilker como su empleado.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Julieta no quiere hablar con Valentina ni con su madre, está muy enojada y no confía en nadie, siente que todos le ocultan cosas. Ana Belén tiene miedo que Valentina le cuente la verdad a Julieta y se haga pasar por victima en vez de la mujer ambiciosa que era cuando le alquilo el vientre. Magdalena y Agustín discuten por la galería de arte y por el hijo que tienen. Agustín chantajea a Magdalena con la tenencia de Rodrigo a cambio de la galería que le pertenece a ella por ser una herencia familiar. Marilyn se imagina a Ricardo como un hombre perfecto. Valentina habla con Efraín y le cuenta que estuvo a punto de decirle toda la verdad a Julieta pero que llego Ana Belén y no lo pudo hacer.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo intenta rescatar a Ricardito mientras enfrenta la enfermedad de Elizabeth, quien necesita una biopsia medular. Katiuska es descubierta visitando a una bruja y abandona la casa de los Tariffi tras ser confrontada. En paralelo, Marcelo y Graciela se divorcian, mientras María del Pilar celebra el suceso. La policía identifica a Carrero como el secuestrador, y Ricardo se dispone a pagar el rescate personalmente, temiendo por su vida y encargando el cuidado de sus hijos a Manuela.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Humberto descubre en el cuarto de Eustoquio los documentos del Bramón y se los muestra a Isaías, quien corre a contarle a Blanca: son sus tierras. Amalia enfrenta a Rivero por las acusaciones contra Alejandro; Erasto llega y la galantea. Alejandro sorprende a Carlos declarándole a Rosa que se enamora de ella; los expulsa furioso. Andreína se casa con Robert tras llegar a la iglesia en camioneta. Eustoquio descubre a Consuelo y Blanca buscando los papeles en su apartamento. Erasto invade la recepción y exige a Natalia. Adolfo lo confronta amenazándolo con la policía.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Clemencia promete renunciar a su venganza por su amor a Augusto. Augusto se siente culpable de haberla engañado con María Gracia y espera que su historia con ella termine así de rápido como empezó. Artemio Ansola está internado en el hospital que trabaja Augusto, en grave estado debido a la enfermedad que padece. Artemio sabe que pronto va a morir y no quiere llevarse consigo un gran secreto. Él sabe que fue lo que pasó con la hija perdida de Clemencia.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Sin tanto clamor ni culpa, Guillermo busca la excusa perfecta para dejar a Yenny un día antes del gran acontecimiento que significa la boda entre Ana y Cristóbal. Guillermo encontró un perrito abandonado en la autopista, y cuando quiso ingresarlo a su apartamento, Yenny le pidió que se lo llevara a otra parte. Un pequeño e inocuo motivo, pero la gran salvedad para Guillermo que sin sentir un ápice de pena, abandona a Yenny, dejándola sola con su pequeña hija. Y es que esta noticia debe contársela con urgencia a Ana, ya que aún conserva una última esperanza en que ese matrimonio no llegue a concretarse.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Tras una intensa interpretación de sus personajes en la trama de la película de Junior Graciela y Atanasio se reconcilian llevando así a la realidad sus sentimientos tras hacer pareja juntos en la filmación. En el centro comercial Briggite y Gisela se encuentran para rivalizar una ves mas haciendo alarde de las ofensas que las llevan a herirse la una a la otra | Briggite aprovecha la ocasión para insistir ante Gisela del supuesto y romántico interés que Atanasio siente por ella.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Brenda le pide a Gabriel si se puede quedar con el niño para que ella pueda salir y tener una vida propia. Gabriel le propone contratar una niñera o una guardería porque él no tiene tiempo. Magdalena escucha que Angie y Gabriel se van de segunda luna de miel. Epi beso a Valentina, pero ella no entiende nada porque cree que él es gay. Nayarí le explica al barrio que el Capitán no es ningún santo como creen todos, que fue un buen hombre pero que no hace milagros. Gabriel va a cuidar al bebe junto a Epi para que Brenda pueda tener su cita con Ricardo. Marilyn llama a Angie para contarle que Gabriel tiene un hijo con Brenda.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardito aparece sano y salvo luego de que Candelaria lo dejara en una iglesia, donde Elizabeth lo encuentra tras pedir un milagro. Ricardo descubre que Elizabeth está gravemente enferma y corre riesgo de morir, una verdad que usa para suplicarle a Manuela que no lo abandone. Mientras tanto, Katiuska asesina a Carrero y queda desconcertada por el intento de rescate fallido. A pesar de la alegría por el regreso del niño, la tragedia médica de Elizabeth marca el destino de la familia.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Erasto se lleva a Natalia de la fiesta y la golpea obligándola a arrodillarse. Le habla como si fuera Consuelo. Eustoquio confiesa a Isaías su infancia traumática jurando venganza contra todos. Robert y Andreína celebran sentando bases del matrimonio. Junior discute con Rosa porque ella se niega a dormir con él. Rosalía visita a Erasto y le revela los planes de Alejandro sobre las tierras. Eustoquio se niega a entregar los documentos a Blanca, prefiriendo extorsionar a Erasto. Rosa anuncia que irá a hablar con su madre Carmen Rosa para que se mude con ellos.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Clemencia va al hospital a ver a Artemio para preguntarle sobre el paradero de su hija. Artemio se encuentra en muy mal estado de salud pero puede decirle algo, le alcanza a decir que había sido él quien le había quitado a su hija en la creencia de que Clemencia había muerto y la había llevado con Olga Valdez pero luego trata de hablar y no puede más y muere. Clemencia se queda angustiada porque Olga Valdez está en cama y no puede hablar ni moverse.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Ana sigue en duda de casarse con Cristóbal o salir corriendo a buscar a Guillermo para decirle cuanto lo ama. Guillermo le dice a Pedro que no cree que sea Ana la que le contesto el mensaje de texto, ya que ella es muy comprensiva y está enamorada de él. Marilda quiere tratar de convencer a sus hijos para que no vayan a la boda y así ella no se queda sola en la casa. Pedro es el complica de Cristóbal para separar a Ana de Guillermo y evitar que se junten y se den cuenta que se aman y que Guillermo dejo a Yenny. Carlos Enrique quiere reconquistar a su mujer pero lo que siente por Lazara es más fuerte y no lo puede controlar.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: En la cancha de basquet Yubiri se reúne con Wilker para fijarle a este su posición al sentirse desplazada en su vida por sus admiradoras y su carrera | Yubiri siguiendo el consejo de Briggite y Bienvenida que la obligan a buscar su felicidad le plantea a Wilker el termino de su noviazgo a pesar de amarlo | Wilker sintiéndose temeroso de llegar a perder el amor de Yubiri le hace a esta la promesa de cambiar muy a pesar de su fama para continuar teniéndola como novia.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Angie no le cree a su marido que tenga un hijo con Brenda. Magdalena se asegura que Sofía le salga de testigo en su juicio de divorcio pero lo que no sabe es que ella está en la cama junto a Agustín, planeando perjudicarla. Efraín llega a su casa después de tener sexo a Valentina y encuentra a su esposa trabajando, la saluda y le miente acerca de dónde viene. Gabriel le cuenta a Angie que dono semen para parejas que no pueden tener bebes, a cambio de dinero. Angie se fue de la casa a pasar la noche fuera para pensar acerca de lo que hizo su marido.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Manuela deja la mansión Tariffi pero apoya a Ricardo ante la enfermedad de Elizabeth. Cecilia llega a Caracas por el secuestro de Ricardito y reclama la custodia de sus sobrinos, enfrentándose a Ricardo. Candelaria es detenida y Elizabeth hospitalizada tras un desmayo. En el ámbito amoroso, Margot rompe con Alejandro tras descubrir su infidelidad, mientras Katiuska conspira para casarse con Ricardo y Marcelo impone los términos de su boda a María del Pilar.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Consuelo decide romper sociedad con Rosalía tras el atentado. Alejandro le pide a José Luis vigilar a Rosa. Carlos enfrenta a Rosalía haciéndole ver el daño que hace. Vilma se ala con Erasto contra Adolfo. Rosa va camino a la tienda de Consuelo pensando cómo enfrentarla, pero Eustoquio la engaña con falsos documentos y la lleva al monte para matarla. Junior empieza a perder la memoria preocupando a Marisela. Alejandro investiga en la Guajira cuando otro auto lo embiste sacando su carro de la carretera. Humberto chantajea a Erasto con copias de los documentos del Bramón.

Durante el año siguiente, deja de beber, vuelve a entrar en la vida de su hijo del que estaba separado, reaviva viejas amistades, se enamora... y pronto descubre que a veces en la vida sólo se necesita un pequeño cambio.

programme.title: La Cacería: En el fin del mundo
programme.desc: La pesadilla comienza cuando José Mirkovic, un adolescente solitario y alumno de un colegio de curas, desaparece tras una noche de fiesta. Ante la indiferencia policial y el silencio de la Iglesia, su madre, Susana Rivera, inicia una cruzada para descubrir la verdad. Tras semanas sin respuestas, aparece un extraño que ofrece esperanza: César Rojas, ex policía convertido en investigador privado, marcado por un pasado turbulento. Junto a la joven oficial Antonia Loij, Rojas sigue el rastro del enigmático padre Correa, ex director del colegio de José, quien parece esconder más de un secreto. Mientras Susana y Rojas luchan por resolver el caso y descubrir qué le sucedió a José, en Santiago el capitán Rodrigo Carrasco, antiguo compañero de Rojas en la policía, recibe una alerta sobre el caso. En las sombras, una red de encubrimientos comienza a cerrarse, mientras crece el temor de que este y otros crímenes enterrados salgan a la luz.

programme.title: El Tercer Reich en Color
programme.desc: Las imágenes del Tercer Reich en la memoria de generaciones siempre se conservan en blanco y negro. Pero ocultas en archivos fílmicos y colecciones privadas, también se han conservado imágenes completamente diferentes, en color. Tomadas en las playas de Normandía y en sencillos festivales folclóricos, documentan las atrocidades de la Wehrmacht durante la guerra y la vida en la granja de montaña de Hitler, y aportan una realidad opresiva a las imágenes del criminal régimen nazi.

programme.desc: Una estrella de telerrealidad deja L. A. y se dirige a territorio Amish, donde descubrirá una nueva realidad.

programme.title: Una sorpresa real
programme.desc: Cuando el novio de Riley, Mandla, la invita a Sudáfrica para conocer a su familia, ella se sorprende al descubrir que él es un príncipe. La noticia pone en peligro la confianza de Riley en Mandla.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Lucía se besa con Melo delante de todos a pesar de la prohibición de su padre. Esa misma noche, Esmeralda escapa de la casa. Por otra parte, Alejandro le confiesa al Alcalde que está enamorado de Reina, mientras el pueblo es acosado por maleantes que destruyen todo a su paso.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Cuando ortega se entera que su prima sale con Alejandro, se enfurece. Ese día, cuando los maleantes se meten a la finca de Alcides, los campesinos se defienden y hieren a la novia del Zarco. Mientras tanto, Olga continúa empeñada en no casarse y en conquistar al Padre Javier.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Eduardo le pide a Esmeralda que sean novios, obviamente al estar enamorada de Ricardo lo rechaza, días después de haber hecho una denuncia radial de la situación en la Victoria, el reportero amigo de Alejandro es asesinado. Por esos días, Eduardo engaña a Alcira, quedándose con todo lo que le pertenecía.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Ortega pierde las licitaciones y Eduardo lo obliga a dejar la casa con su hija, luego roba y desaparece a Alcira. Más tarde, los Guerrero sufren una explosión en la mina que los deja atrapados. Tras horas de esfuerzo, Alejandro, Ricardo y Alcides son rescatados, dejando a Ortega frustrado por no lograr matarlos.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: El segundo derrumbe atrapa la pierna de Alcides. Esa noche Reina confronta a Ortega, quien la amenaza de muerte. Eduardo se une a uno de los caciques de la zona para acabar con Ortega y con el Zarco, logrando someterlos y capturarlos. Días después, Olga termina por comprometerse con Alcides cuando él queda en silla de ruedas.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Eduardo obliga a Esmeralda a comprometerse. Alcira regresa para denunciarlo y recuperar sus tierras, lo que divide a la familia tras enfrentarlo Alejandro y Ricardo. Días después, Olga se casa con Alcides y Esmeralda con Eduardo, quien ordena asesinar a Ortega a manos de “El Tigre” y “El Cascabel”.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Finalmente, Eduardo es culpado por varios crímenes, pero su hermano Ricardo logra detenerlo antes de que sea atrapado por la Policía. Tras 20 años de cárcel, Eduardo cumple su condena y es liberado.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Eduardo rechaza a toda su familia, haciendo alianzas políticas para quitarle las minas a su papá y hermanos, Esmeralda se encuentra con Ricardo, a pesar de que él no la ha olvidado, ella lo rechaza pues no pretende volver al estar apurada intentando sacar a su hijo de la Victoria. Más adelante, Eduardo se encuentra con Esmeralda cuando a él le hacen un atentado.

programme.title: Go Astro Boy Go!
programme.desc: Lo que parece ser un trabajo rutinario de control de plagas se convierte en una pesadilla al estilo de los 'Gremlins' mientras Astro y el equipo intentan derrotar a un ejército creciente de ratas fuera de control que ha descendido sobre un centro comercial. Lo que empeora las cosas es que la clave de por qué las ratas se han vuelto tan locas no se puede ver ni tocar, ¡solo se puede oler!

programme.title: Amo La Cocina
programme.desc: Después de una mala crítica de un crítico y una charla del chef Gordon Ramsay, un chef londinense talentoso pero afligido convierte un pub rural en un restaurante gourmet. Su postre llama la atención (y el sabor) de Kate, y pronto descubren que la receta para la verdadera felicidad es una pizca de trabajo en equipo y mucho amor.

programme.title: Una Navidad Casi Perfecta
programme.desc: Después de perder su trabajo y a su novio, una aspirante a novelista romántica se muda de su apartamento en Londres a una casa en la playa en Sunshine Coast, donde descubre que el amor puede ser a la vez perfecto y complicado.

programme.title: El Tercer Reich en Color
programme.desc: Las imágenes del Tercer Reich en la memoria de generaciones siempre se conservan en blanco y negro. Pero ocultas en archivos fílmicos y colecciones privadas, también se han conservado imágenes completamente diferentes, en color. Tomadas en las playas de Normandía y en sencillos festivales folclóricos, documentan las atrocidades de la Wehrmacht durante la guerra y la vida en la granja de montaña de Hitler, y aportan una realidad opresiva a las imágenes del criminal régimen nazi.

programme.title: Laberinto de Sombras

programme.title: El Devorador de Huesos
programme.desc: Cuando un equipo comienza a excavar en el desierto, la policía local se enfrenta a una serie de macabros asesinatos. En estos extraños crímenes, las víctimas han sido despojadas de sus huesos mediante un método que ni siquiera la comunidad médica logra explicar. Sin saberlo, el equipo ha desatado a un antiguo espíritu indígena —el Devorador de Huesos— que busca vengarse.

programme.title: Go Astro Boy Go!
programme.desc: El profesor Elefun y el Dr. Blunt están enfrascados en una batalla por un concurso para ver quién puede aterrizar un huevo de forma segura tras soltarlo, utilizando la resistencia del viento. La competición se ve interrumpida por una llamada de auxilio del aeropuerto de Pekín, donde la jefa de control de tráfico aéreo, Maylin, intenta en vano arreglar el sistema de comunicaciones. Suzu restablece el contacto por radio con los dos últimos aviones que deben aterrizar, y el primero desciende sano y salvo con la ayuda de uno de los artilugios de Astro Kitty. Pero a medida que la tormenta de granizo se intensifica, los granizos dañan los motores del último avión, haciendo que los pilotos pierdan el control. ¡Parece que el avión se estrellará en el centro de Pekín! En una tensa misión a gran velocidad, Astro utiliza una carpa gigante como paracaídas para frenar el avión, mientras Astro Kitty lo estabiliza. Juntos, el Equipo Astro aterriza el avión de forma segura, llevando la misión a un final de infarto.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Dale searches for priceless motorcycles to bring to the Vegas auction.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: The RM Auction Company has worked with Dale before as a buyer, seller, historian, and caretaker at the prestigious Lee Hartung auction. But this event is no last minute rush to define one man’s treasures. This is a well calculated, time consuming, multi-media, and multi motorcycle and prized art deal.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: The Senior Vice President at Home Depot, Gordon Erickson at is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hard-ware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Promoters of the prestigious Amelia Island Concourse have called on Dale to develop a show and field bikes for an “Orphan Bike” show. They have defined orphan bike as extremely rare, non Harley or Indian machines.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.title: What's in the Barn

With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: What's in the Barn

programme.title: What's in the Barn

programme.title: What's in the Barn

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: Ebb and Flo

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: Rookie Robot

programme.title: Rookie Robot

programme.title: Rookie Robot

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: Rookie Robot

Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The mission of Shoot United is to be a content resource for millions of shooters and a place where people can learn, build confidence and find ways to participate. Through films, educational videos and articles, SU has impacted countless shooters all over the world. In this episode, join Shoot United Ambassadors as they inspire and educate through a series of instructional videos and stories in pistol, self-defense, trap and skeet and sporting clays. - GUESTS: Thea Van Sync (Team Winchester) Callie Farill (Team Winchester) Becky Yackley (Team Winchester) Theo Ribbs (Team Winchester) Jessica Hook (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Each year we get to spend time in camp with some of our best friends. Zach from Big & J gets some time in a blind while reflecting on what hunting in Texas means to him. Texas provides a wide variety of game, and chasing these creatures all across the state is some of the best times had.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: In 2010, Amberly Snyder’s life changed forever when an accident left her paralyzed from the waist-down. Her comeback story not unlike something you’d see in a movie…in fact it inspired one. Disabled Outdoorsmen USA contacted TTHA and set up this hunt and we were fortunate enough to be able to capture just some of Amberly’s story and her harvest of a beautiful Axis buck at the G2 Ranch in the spring of 2022.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: This week we are rolling along side the crew from Double T Outfitters. Management plays a huge role in every outfitters success every year. Bret and his team have a strong management plan in place and these guys had a blast with a group of out of state hunters.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: The bond between and parent and child can grow in many ways, but nothing compares to the bond shared when hunting. The annual Father-Son hunt at FE Hill Outfitters has becoming a tradition for Heath and his son Gavin and in 2021, Gavin was able to take his largest buck to date, with his dad Heath behind the camera.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor head to the iconic Seven Mile Bridge targeting big jack crevasses and permit.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor head offshore to the Marathon Hump, taking advantage of the 26-feet hybrid boat's versatility to find some exciting Blackfin and Skipjack Tuna fishing.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor are joined by scientist Nick Haddad, who educates our hosts and the fishing world on the various descending devices used to preserve stressed catch from deeper waters as the three of them get into some fun Red Snapper fishing off the coast of Marathon, Florida in the Keys.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor are joined by Rich's son Reed, who takes the wheel and directs the team into some amazing early morning baby tarpon fishing in the Everglades.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor take Hunter Smallback into the Everglades for some snook fishing, and the action really heats up when some hungry Lemon sharks crash the party.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor catch two thirds of a slam when they bring Tom’s new Yellowfin 24’ Bay up to Key Largo for some exciting flats fishing.

programme.title: Captain's Log
programme.desc: Capt. Jonathan Moss is in Florida’s Big Bend, inshore fishing the Negative Low Tide on an Airboat!

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: The next stop on our Florida Keys adventure brings Rush Maltz to the legendary waters of Islamorada — a destination known for its laid-back island vibe, world-class fishing, fine dining, and easy access to the reef. Joining locals Jimmy Hendrix and Jordi Hortensi, the game plan is simple: check in by boat, chase fish, eat well, and go dive. From kite fishing the reef to fresh seafood and great company, this episode is all about experiencing the true rhythm of a Florida Keys vacation.

programme.title: Road Trip Angler
programme.desc: In this episode of Road Trip Angler, host Jameson Redding takes guests Jesse Laspeyre and Brooks Beatty on a multi-day adventure exploring the Forgotten Coast along the Florida Adventure Trail, chasing fish and adventure at every turn.

programme.title: Destination Dive
programme.desc: Experience the magic of shore diving from one of the Keys’ most scenic beaches. The episode also follows military veterans discovering healing and renewed purpose through diving.

programme.title: Dirt
programme.desc: New. York. City. That’s where our host Josh Rosen kicks off his journey in Episode 4—and where he lived for 16 years and started up the surf-centric apparel brand, Saturdays NYC. Back in his old stomping grounds, Josh first meets up with the award-winning chef and Mumbai native, Chintan Pandya, currently blowing up the New York food scene with his unapologetic and authentic Indian cuisine (pro tip: try the goat brains). Next, Josh travels through the boroughs, heads upstate, and along the coast to source local ingredients—from sake brewers and pig farmers to catching fresh lobster just 100 miles from Wall Street. As always the adventure will end with a feast, right back in Chintan’s kitchen.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: In the heart of the Zambezi Delta, a team of conservationists have overseen one of the largest range expansions of African lions in modern times. From a reintroduction of 24 lions in 2018, today the population is more than a hundred.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff wade into the flooded timber of the legendary Coca-Cola Woods, where mallards drop through the treetops in waves. Amidst echoes of calling and wingbeats, they experience one of America’s most iconic duck hunts.

programme.title: Destination Dive
programme.desc: In this episode, we will highlight what’s being done in the Florida Keys to protect and save the reefs. We will show innovative solutions researchers have created to protect the coral and showcase the recovery that’s taking place.

programme.title: Stomping Grounds
programme.desc: From battling towering 12-foot waves in the Gulf of Alaska, to reeling in colossal 200 lb. halibut, they discover firsthand the rugged beauty of America's 49th state. This episode highlights Lindell Yachts as a top builder of rugged offshore sportfishing yachts, as well as Radon Boats as great pilothouse fishing and guide boats.

programme.title: Fox Hollow Outdoors
programme.desc: Michael continues the family tradition of fish stew and gathering, with hopes that Larkin will pass on the same traditions.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: As the pressure of opening his new store builds, Josh steps away from the chaos and returns to the water for a solo wade fishing trip — his first in years.

programme.title: Canadian Whitetail
programme.desc: With few mature bucks to hunt Dean heads out to put his time in regardless because anything, can happen.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The team at Winchester Ammunition has arrived in Oregon to visit the Leupold Long Range Academy. There, they’ll put Winchester’s new “Supreme Long Range” ammunition to the test, pushing its performance across demanding long-range scenarios. - - With precision, consistency, and confidence on the line, the team is eager to demonstrate exactly what “Precision Rifle Perfected” means when every shot counts.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Join Benny Spies of Team Winchester as he shares stories of his upbringing in South Dakota. From cherished family photos to duck seasons of the past, learn how a passion for hunting was ignited and became a way of life for Benny and his family.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, we uncover true accounts from around the world that feel almost impossible. A fisherman off the coast of Chile is taken by a breaching whale. A diver vanishes into darkness and finds himself trapped inside the mouth of a humpback whale. Two kayakers are lifted from the water by something massive lurking just below the surface of the ocean. - These are not legends. These are real people telling their stories. - We also revisit one of the most powerful moments in the Bible. The story of Jonah. Scripture tells us that God prepared a great fish to swallow Jonah for a divine purpose. Could something like that still happen today? What does science say about surviving inside a whale? And are these modern encounters more than just coincidence?

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: The movie Jaws was inspired by a string of shark attacks... some in FRESHWATER! In this eerie episode of Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green explores the shocking reality of sharks found in freshwater. From bull sharks traveling up the Mississippi River to strange reports out of the Great Lakes, we examine how far these predators can really go. You'll hear about bull sharks in Lake Nicaragua, the science behind their survival in rivers and lakes, and theories about whether they could adapt to colder waters. It's a mix of strange history, biology, and firsthand accounts that might make you think twice before jumping in.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: Deep in the backroads of the Midwest there are stories locals rarely tell out loud. Stories of pale figures with oversized heads watching from the trees. Stories passed down in whispers and warnings. The Melon Heads legend has haunted Michigan, Ohio, and surrounding states for decades. Some say they are the result of dark experiments. Others believe they are something far older. Something that never left the woods.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff hear about the dangers of fishing for Bluefin Tuna in the Atlantic Ocean from locals in Gloucester, Massachusetts. Then they head 30 miles out onto the open ocean with Darrin of Reel Respect Charters in the hopes of landing their own giant.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff team up with their friends from Boss Shotshells in South Dakota for a high-energy upland hunt, pursuing wild pheasants with the help of skilled hunting dogs. The adventure takes a quirky turn with a visit to the iconic Corn Palace.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: After harvesting a tough Anatolian Chamois, Mark Peterson heads south to the Taurus Mountains for his next challenge: The Bezoar Ibex. With the pre-rut in full swing, most Ibex are in small bachelor groups. It's only a matter of time before Mark spots a mature trophy—requiring skill, patience, and a solid understanding of this rugged terrain.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson returns to the stunning island of Dugi Otok in Croatia for his third time in pursuit of a Kri Kri ibex. This Mediterranean gem offers a true sportsman's paradise, home to an incredible variety of huntable species. While the island presents opportunities for Axis Deer and other game—which Mark briefly glasses during his adventure—the primary focus remains on connecting with a quality Kri Kri Ibex. Join Mark as he navigates the familiar yet ever-challenging terrain of Dugi Otok.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Follow along with Mark Peterson as he heads north to Nunavut within the Arctic Circle. On this trip, he has brought along his Gunwerks muzzleloader as well as his Gunwerks rifle. With two Caribou tags and a Musk Ox tag in his pocket, he’s excited to put both firearms to use. The muzzleloader is up to bat first. With the rocky, wide open tundra terrain it makes it more of a challenge to get close enough with the muzzleloader.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: This week is all about Woody, a fearless Jack Russle who spends his free time doing everything from Black Bear hunting in Vancouver to Sheep hunting in the mountains.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson has one more tag in his pocket after harvesting both a Central Barren Ground Caribou and a Muskox with his Gunwerks muzzleloader on day one. This time, he has his Gunwerks rifle in hand. The conditions have been perfect, but there is a front pushing in with a ton of rain coming so Mark is eager to fill his final tag before the bad weather hits. Spotting a large group of Caribou with one big one mixed in early on in the day, he is hoping to have success and end his trip to Nunavut off with a bang!

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson heads out on a unique hunt for the rare Anatolian Chamois, a mountain dweller found in the high elevations of northern Turkey. With a storm rolling in, Mark hopes the weather will push the Chamois down from their usual heights, giving him a rare chance to track this prey across the challenging landscape.

programme.title: Bearded Buck
programme.desc: In this episode, we're headed out to Oklahoma to follow along with the Sharp brothers as they hunt whitetails in their home state. You never know what to expect with these two but one thing you can always rely on is that they always have some big deer to go after!

programme.title: American Heroes Outdoors
programme.desc: On this episode we travel to Rock Falls Raceway in Wisconsin to highlight our nations heroes who have made drag racing and serving our country a way of life! We also honor our next Fargo Scheels Hometown hero, Elizabeth Miller.

programme.title: American Heroes Outdoors
programme.desc: On this episode, we travel north of the border for an unforgettable PART 1 Canadian fly-in fishing trip with Mandatory Fun Outdoors. We also highlight our next Scheels Hometown Hero, Jay Strande!

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: Vietnam war veteran Don Weber recounts his amazing journey through survivors guilt, PTSD and starting over.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: U.S. Army veteran Carlos Powell tells of family sacrifice and fighting his post service “demons.”

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: It's the second day of the Alabama Turkey season, and we hit the woods with Dr. Mike Chamberlain and Aaron Warbritton from The Hunting Public in search of a longbeard. Watching turkeys just being turkeys, and spending time with great friends is why turkey hunting is just different to us.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: This one is special. We took Ron aka “Don”, a WoodHaven employee who helps assemble our pot calls, out to Tennessee for a turkey hunt he’ll never forget. After 35 years of not harvesting a Turkey, Don finally gets his shot.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Some mornings just remind you why we do this. We found ourselves in Southwest Alabama on one of the prettiest mornings a turkey hunter could ever ask for — cool air, soft light breaking through the timber, and gobbles echoing through the hardwoods. Even better, we got to share it with a great friend, and that’s what makes hunts like this truly special. This is what turkey hunting is all about — good friends, beautiful mornings, and chasing longbeards in God’s country.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: This Kentucky trip is one we’ll be talking about for a long time. Three longbeards hit the ground, but honestly, it’s the time spent in the woods with good friends that made this hunt what it was. We had birds gobbling, lots of laughs, and a memories that will last a lifetime, and that’s what makes turkey hunting so addicting. These are the kind of hunts you don’t take for granted.

programme.title: Reel Animals
programme.desc: Capt. Mike Anderson and Capt. Ryan Rickard keep track of the catch during an epic day in Steinhatchee, FL.

programme.title: Reel Animals
programme.desc: Part 2 of this friendly competition picks right back up where things left off in Steinhatchee, FL with Capt. Mike Anderson and Capt. Ryan Rickard.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: Josh and George from Two Georges Marina battle the wind and tide on a tough day of fishing which leads Josh to fish another day, solely for revenge on the Sheepshead!

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: Join Captain Josh and Sheriff Eric Aden for a day of fishing and fun in Destin, Florida. These two friends hit the water, catching fish both offshore and inshore, and reeling in some impressive catches. With plenty of laughs, great stories, and a few surprises along the way, this episode is all about the joy of fishing and the bond between two guys who love the sea.

programme.title: Flats Class
programme.desc: Capt. CA looks back on 20 years of Flats Class TV and picks some of his favorite moments to revisit.

programme.title: Flats Class
programme.desc: CA’s skiff gets an upgrade. Now no fish is safe.

programme.title: Flats Class
programme.desc: Low country BBQ and Redfish? What more do you want?

programme.title: Flats Class
programme.desc: CA heads to the scenic Low country of South Carolina for part one of an epic two-part redfish adventure.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of Salmon fishing and hunting black tail deer. Whilst traversing steep mountains in the company of Kodiak brown bears and taking on cold Alaskan waters, Andy presents useful information for fellow outdoor enthusiasts all whilst building friendships with the great people of Kodiak Big Timber Lodge.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting. From the pressure of national competition to the routines that build confidence, they reveal how preparation, mental focus, and years of dedication lead to success. The transcript emphasizes that managing pressure is a learned skill, supported by consistent routines and trust in dependable equipment like Winchester AA shotshells. - As the two champions train, mentor the next generation, and reflect on the journeys that shaped their careers, the episode celebrates more than trophies. With Kim's Olympic legacy and Desi's Hall of Fame induction, the passion, perseverance, and commitment to excellence that continue to inspire shooters across the country.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester team members and employees meet up at the Keefer Brothers property in Missouri for a multi day deer camp. Along for the ride are outdoor editors Scott Ergas and Dave Hurteau. Chris and Casey are on the search for some large bucks, as well as showing the people at the camp a great time and what deer season is all about.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor
programme.desc: Capt. Mike Avinon takes Blair off Naples for a variety of fish.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor
programme.desc: Capt. Blair tries for an upgrade off the coast of Naples.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: For Mike Pentecost and his son Jacob, Illinois deer camp has become a tradition they look forward to every single year. It’s a place filled with memories, time spent together, and a shared love for chasing whitetails.But this trip carries a little more meaning. At 17 years old, Jacob is heading into his final year of being eligible for Illinois’ special youth season and he and Mike are hoping to make one last trip to deer camp count.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 1 of the British episodes, Andy starts his road trip around the United Kingdom in the Cotswolds where he sets out to hunt and taste the beautiful venison that Michelin star chef, Mark Robinson has to offer. He then proceeds to travel to the border of Scotland where he samples some of the finest and most historic bird shooting practices found throughout the British Isles.
These hunters know the key to taking giant whitetails consistently is all about being in the right place at the right time. Brady Snyder hunts down a giant 200″ buck in Iowa from 2023.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: For decades, Paul Butski has set the standard in turkey calling. His name is etched into the NWTF Grand National Calling Championships Hall of Fame, and his influence stretches far beyond the stage. He didn’t just win competitions, he shaped the way we talk to turkeys – and more importantly, the way we hunt them.
If you hunt big whitetails this is a must see! Follow Adam Hays and Lee Lakosky as they hunt for multiple giants and learn some tactics for harvesting monster whitetails!

programme.title: Bearded Buck
programme.desc: After starting turkey season off on the road, it's time for us to come back home to Pennsylvania and hunt some turkeys on our home turf! Also joining us this week are our good friends from The Grind Outdoors who come in to hunt some long beards with us.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: It’s still opening week of bow season in Oklahoma and the crew has three tags left to fill.

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.desc: After taking 2 great bucks in Nebraska, the Road Trips crew came back home to Georgia with Tyler and Rigsby taking bucks on back to back sits! Dash makes 3 Georgia bucks in 3 sits!

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Join Benny Spies of Team Winchester as he shares stories of his upbringing in South Dakota. From cherished family photos to duck seasons of the past, learn how a passion for hunting was ignited and became a way of life for Benny and his family.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Dan Schmidt sits down with Adam Hays to discuss the key strategies he uses to tag trophy-class whitetails year after year, from the U.S. to Canada.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We join Denny McMahan on this episode at the legendary Thumbtack Ranch in South Texas. Denny was nominated by his wife for Bucks for the Brave program hosted by Trinity Oaks. After dedicating his life to service in the US Army and law enforcement, he now continues the mission by teaching at the police academy. Denny is a true hero in his community - someone who sacrifices his time, his well being, and his life in service to others, never asking for anything in return.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We follow along with the crew from Struttinbuck on their annual Father Son hunt at FE Hill. No matter what happens throughout the year this is always a must have trip and a time to settle down and enjoy the great outdoors.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his son, Logan visit the beautiful country of New Zealand. From visiting Vineyards and sampling wine, to helicopter hunts for Himalayan Tahr, this episode is everything that is a hunters dream. As well as harvesting the wild game New Zealand has to offer Andy also learns about the importance of the conservation efforts that hunting has in this country from locals in which he spends time with.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode of Hunting Land Man, Asa is on a roll. She fills her second and third turkey tags of the year, capping off an incredible season and tagging out in Mississippi. The highlight of the week came when she got to experience her very first double-up with her dad, Slade. Sharing a moment like that in the turkey woods is something they'll never forget, making this a truly unforgettable hunt.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: On this episode of Hunting Land Man Season 3, Slade puts in some early summer farm work to Ensure his target bucks are well fed! Slade also Talks about his Target buck for the year, "Pope"! Slade is laying the trap early in hopes "Pope" makes a mistake early!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: On this episode of Hunting Land Man, Slade does more summer food plot prep in hopes "Pope" will make an appearance! With Rain on the way Slade is able to disk and seed his "Pope" Summer spot!

programme.title: Ship Shape TV
programme.desc: During this episode of Ship Shape TV Essentials the SSTV team is taking - the Marine Surplus Console for the Aqua sport project and giving it a much needed face lift. They meet the team at Boat Outfitters to find an acrylic covering board to fit the console and cover the pre existing holes. They then head over to meet with crew at AwlGrip to get some ideas on color matching the console with the Aqua sport.

programme.title: Ship Shape TV
programme.desc: During this episode of Ship Shape TV Essentials the SSTV team take a trip to Marine Surplus in order to gather miscellaneous parts for AquaSport project such as cleats, rod holders, and a rub rail getting them one step closer to finishing the project. The crew then heads back to the project were they get to work on installing the parts gathered and getting the AquaSport accessorized.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: This episode we are not going far, yeah, like 5ooyards from the front porch of my house. From new box stands, good help and maybe even a monster buck. This is all going on now on Hunting Land Man TV.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: This episode the Missouri project continues, and we are getting the 344 looking right! New plots, old plots, cutting beans, new stand, oh, and two big bucks go down over the Iowa plot. This is all going on now on Hunting Land Man TV.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode its doe day every day, well every day until after Christmas day! That’s when THE BIG 10 met his maker. Oh, and Slade takes it back to the beginning and SELF FILMS.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, we are smacking turkeys and making mid-term investments. 1031 Tax money is the number one way to build your land portfolio and create a place for your family to enjoy. Follow along as we turn a old beat up piece of dirt and turn it into the ultimate place ground for a hunter such as myself. From habitat to harvest we have been on fire.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: Lifelong cowboy and Oklahoma native Bill Parker is believed to be the 1st man to reach the shores of Normandy on D-day…June 6th 1944.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: An Honor No One Wants: A Gold Star Family is the immediate family - member(s) of a fallen soldier who died while serving in a time of conflict. - Mike Brennan honors the memory his son…American hero Josh Brennan.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: Retired Colonel Paul Wharton shares his memories of leading his soldiers - while teaching his own children the philosophy of “ mission, men and me.”

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: After surviving the Iranian ballistic missiles hitting Iraq's Al Asad air base, - Aaron Futrell recounts his memories of that horrible night.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Another great hunt this week with Intrepid Care. We have the chance to hang out with some Veterans from all over the country. We gather to tell stories, build relationships, and just enjoy the great outdoors. This trip is action packed and the guys are chasing South Texas hogs from the ground.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Every year, hunters from across the country flock to various parts of Texas to extend their hunting season. This year, our friends from Struttinbuck did just the same. Matt and Clede make the long drive to Del Rio to hunt South Texas bucks right on the Mexico border.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We are blessed today to hunt with Cole Dutton for the Inaugural Pierce Dutton Memorial Hunt. We are honored to spend a weekend with Cole and his family at the G2 Ranch. Disabled Outdoorsman has played a huge part in getting those less fortunate outdoors. We are truly blessed to be able to follow along and capture these great moments.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: It’s that time again—when the boys from StruttinBuck load up and head out of Arkansas, bound for Fairfield, Texas and the FE Hill Ranch. Another year, another hunt, and another chapter in a tradition that’s grown into something far bigger than the hunt itself. This annual father-son trip is built on early mornings, shared stories, and moments that stick with you long after the season ends. It’s the memories made over the years that keep calling them back—and this year will be no different.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We follow along with the crew from Struttinbuck on their annual Father Son hunt at FE Hill. No matter what happens throughout the year this is always a must have trip and a time to settle down and enjoy the great outdoors.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We join Blake Barnett alongside hunter Jimmy Reynolds as they take part in the 2nd Annual Pierce Dutton Memorial Hunt. This meaningful whitetail hunt is made possible by the great folks at Disabled Outdoorsmen. Jimmy settles in at the G2 Ranch in South Texas, where prime whitetail country and a shared passion for the outdoors set the stage for an unforgettable hunt.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We are blessed for the opportunity to follow along the guys from Trinity Oaks for Bucks for the Brave. The men and women that served in our armed services and as first responders, had jobs that required the, to be willing to sacrifice their own lives every day, in order to protect or save someone else's. Not many of us can say that, nor understand what that truly means. The things they've had to see, and the sacrifices they've made in their daily lives, can have a profound impact on them. Trinity Oaks' Bucks for the Brave platform allows the loved ones and communities that support these heroes to share their stories and unite us all in honoring and recognizing their service to our great nation. We are proud to continue to be a part of this incredible program, getting these heroes in the outdoors for the hunt of a lifetime.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Join us for an unforgettable Women Go Hunting experience at Legends Ranch in Michigan!

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor
programme.desc: A collection of the fish that didn't make the cut for an episode, so they get their own episode.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor
programme.desc: A look back at the favorites of Season 3.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors
programme.desc: It's that time of the year again. Time to tag some redfish for the FL STAR tournament by CCA. Like always, Leiza and Blair explain the many ways to win big while catching some big reds.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors
programme.desc: Capt. Blair heads out to the very first spot we ever filmed a BWO show, with the first guide ever on BWO Capt. John Beach. - This time they're catching sheepshead, hopefully nobody gets bit this time.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff join a local biologist searching for a white rhino whose tracking collar has failed, leaving it exposed to poachers. As they follow its trail through the African bush, the search builds toward a heart-pounding encounter that none of them will ever forget.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle takes to the water in a way few anglers dare, fishing from a Sea-Doo in search of the ancient lake sturgeon, a species that’s been around since the age of the dinosaurs and can live over 100 years. Hooking into one of North America’s largest freshwater fish from a personal watercraft proves to be a challenge unlike any other.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff embark on a 20-day mission into the Everglades to find the invasive pythons that are plaguing the ecosystem. These apex predators have eliminated more than 90% of fur-bearing animals in their new home. Can they turn the tide, or is the Everglades already lost?

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff get bit by catfish in Southern Oklahoma with YouTuber Nate Williams of Adrenaline Rush Adventures while using the most primitive fishing tactic - hand fishing. Learn from the Chickasaw Nation about the history of this method that has been used by Native Americans for thousands of years.

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.desc: In this episode, Tyler sets up before daylight, calls in a stubborn gobbler, and gets a second chance at the bird that’s been haunting him.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Greg Camp heads back to Nebraska for the third year in a row hoping to put his bow tag on a giant 10 Pointer.

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.desc: Opening Day in Alabama 2026 was one for the books!

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.desc: Part 2 of our Alabama opening week 2026 hunt with our buddies Lee Hubbard and Daniel McAfee.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Atlanta Braves' third baseman Austin Riley is usually spending his September and October holding it down on the hot corner in the MLB playoffs. Being that he can't hunt much during the early part of deer season, he usually hunts hard during December and January in Mississippi. This year was no different. He jumped at the opportunity to head down to the Backwoods testing grounds to hunt with the Small Town TV crew in Yazoo City. Austin capitalizes on a first sit opportunity on a true Mississippi giant over a Backwoods Attraction food plot! Three first sit bucks taken for the Road Trips crew at the Backwoods testing grounds!

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.desc: Michael Pitts kicks off the Georgia bow season with a big 10 pointer.

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Elk Foundation
programme.desc: “Part of our responsibility as citizens in this country is to make sure we not only take care of these resources but we hand it off to the next generation in better condition that we found it.” -Bob Ziehmer, Senior Director of Conservation for Bass Pro Shops & Cabela's Join Bob in New Mexico as he talks about taking care of our natural resources for future generations. Special thanks to Express UU Bar Ranch

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: It’s been 60 years since AA was introduced to the shooting sports world. Since that day, an immeasurable number of AA hulls have hit the ground and countless shooters have stood center stage raising a trophy where millions of dollars have been won. Professional and recreational shooters alike have trusted AA for six decades. In this episode, load up for stories of high school, collegiate competitors and the world’s best as they bust clays with the legendary shot shell. - GUESTS: Zach Keenbaum (Team Winchester) Desi Edmunds (Team Winchester) Kayla Wilgus (Team Winchester) Amy Cawley (Team Winchester) Anthony Matarese (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: For the first time in history, the World English Sporting Clays Championship was held in the United States at the incredible M&M Hunting Preserve owned by the Matarese family in New Jersey. Watch as Winchester’s best shooters vie for Gold as they compete against over 2,500 shooters and 17 countries. We’ll also join the Kids and Clays foundation in Florida as they host an event that will most certainly touch your soul.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Across the country, deer season to many Americans is a rite of passage. For generations, Winchester has been the trusted ammunition choice for hunters…and it’s been a decade since the game-changing Deer Season XP whitetail line was introduced. In this episode, we’ll celebrate the many successes by Team Winchester hunters in the field during whitetail and mule deer firearm seasons across the United States. - GUESTS: Melissa Bachman (Team Winchester) Mark Drury (Team Winchester) Nikki Boxler (Team Winchester) Chris Keefer (Team Winchester) Casey Keefer (Team Winchester) Jason Gilbertson (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The mission of Shoot United is to be a content resource for millions of shooters and a place where people can learn, build confidence and find ways to participate. Through films, educational videos and articles, SU has impacted countless shooters all over the world. In this episode, join Shoot United Ambassadors as they inspire and educate through a series of instructional videos and stories in pistol, self-defense, trap and skeet and sporting clays. - GUESTS: Thea Van Sync (Team Winchester) Callie Farill (Team Winchester) Becky Yackley (Team Winchester) Theo Ribbs (Team Winchester) Jessica Hook (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: How important is the wild harvest to communities in North America? Dan Cabela travels from Kansas to Newfoundland in search of the answer, meeting rural communities that rely on the yearly cycle of wild game harvest.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: Often misunderstood, brown bears are one of North America's most formidable predators. Taking part in a scientific collaring program to better understand predator-prey interactions, Dan Cabela travels to Kodiak Island to meet the research team.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of Salmon fishing and hunting black tail deer. Whilst traversing steep mountains in the company of Kodiak brown bears and taking on cold Alaskan waters, Andy presents useful information for fellow outdoor enthusiasts all whilst building friendships with the great people of Kodiak Big Timber Lodge.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Returning to Venice, Louisiana for the first time in nearly a decade, Rush reconnects with longtime friends Eric and Monique Newman of Journey South Outfitters for an unforgettable inshore fishing adventure in the heart of the Mississippi River Delta. With reports of massive schools of redfish cruising the beaches, Monique (“Moe”) must decide whether to trust the intel and make a bold run down the coast—or rely on her own instincts built from years on the water. The mission is simple: put Rush on a true bull redfish and see if he has what it takes to earn a spot in her coveted “Over 40-Inch Club.” This trip highlights why Venice, Louisiana is considered one of the premier inshore fisheries in the country—and why having the right guide makes all the difference. Target Species: Bull Redfish. Location: Venice, Louisiana – Mississippi Delta. Outfitter: Journey South Outfitters.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: Capt. Justin and Florida WaterSports pro Jeff Lange go deep off Panama City Beach to test the limits of a new battery powered reel. The results are surprising.
